annotations.title: Check a bank card's travel insurance

description: Checks what travel insurance a credit card already includes, from the card's own terms & conditions in HelloSafe's card database. For questions about what a card covers for travel (medical, cancellation, baggage, ski…) or whether it is enough for a trip. The card is identified from its name (and bank / country when given). Returns the covered guarantees with amounts and conditions, the coverage gaps, and the card id, which get_quote accepts as `cardId` to rank offers by how well they fill those gaps. Coverage comes from the card's terms only: anything not returned is not documented.

bankCountry.description: ISO-2 country of the issuing bank (e.g. "US", "FR"). Defaults to the user's country of residence when known — greatly improves matching.

cardId.description: Exact HelloSafe card ID from a previous call: it re-checks that card instead of matching by name.

cardQuery.description: Card name as the user said it, expanded ("American Express Platinum", not "Amex Plat"), with the bank when known ("Chase Sapphire Reserve"). Not needed when cardId is given.

locale.description: Language the user is conversing in, as a BCP 47 tag or 2-letter code (e.g. "fr", "pt-BR"). Guarantee labels are localized with it.

tripContext.description: Optional trip details; they sharpen the gap analysis.

arrivalCountries.description: Destination countries as ISO-2 codes, when the user mentioned a trip.

intent.description: Trip purpose when known — same values as get_quote (forTourism, schengenArea, studyInternship…). Drives the thresholds.

shouldCoverCancellation.description: True when the user cares about cancellation cover.

shouldCoverExtremeSports.description: True for ski / diving / mountaineering trips.

name: check_card_coverage

_assistantGuidance.description: Context of the result: what the widget shows and the facts behind the analysis.

context.description: Facts behind the analysis: sources, what the widget shows, the travel gaps for the trip.

allGuarantees.description: The card's FULL guarantee sheet, grouped by section (travel first). Shown in the widget.

recommended.description: The coverage HelloSafe recommends, when defined.

tab.description: Section key: travelInsurance | carRental | winterSports | protection.

alternatives.description: Other cards matching the query; any of their ids can be passed back as cardId.

bankCountry.description: ISO-2 country of the issuing bank.

currency.description: Currency of the card guarantee amounts.

id.description: HelloSafe card ID: as `cardId`, get_quote ranks offers by how well they complement this card, and this tool re-checks it.

score.description: HelloSafe score for the card travel cover.

cancellationOnlyGap.description: True when cancellation is the ONLY gap: a cancellation-only policy (get_quote intent "cancellation") is then usually much cheaper than full cover.

card.description: The card the analysis is about.

bankCountry.description: ISO-2 country of the issuing bank.

currency.description: Currency of the card guarantee amounts.

id.description: HelloSafe card ID: as `cardId`, get_quote ranks offers by how well they complement this card, and this tool re-checks it.

score.description: HelloSafe score for the card travel cover.

cardWidget.description: Data rendered by the card widget (gaps, catches, full sheet) — not meant for the assistant.

covered.description: Travel guarantees the card really includes, with amounts and conditions from the card T&Cs.

conditions.description: Conditions for the guarantee to apply (e.g. trip paid with the card).

coverage.description: Formatted covered amount from the card T&Cs.

slug.description: Feature slug — same slugs as get_quote offer features.

error.description: Human-readable reason when the check could not run. Absent on success.

gaps.description: Guarantees missing or insufficient for the trip — the offer features a complementary policy should provide.

cardCoverage.description: What the card actually provides, for contrast.

slug.description: Offer feature slug that fills this gap.

thresholdLabel.description: Why the amount is considered insufficient.

translations.description: Localized UI strings consumed by the widget — not meant for the assistant.

unknown.description: Core guarantees with no data on this card: not documented in HelloSafe's data, which is not the same as not covered.
